answer: Rate-limited vouching with slashing: a new agent joins only when an established agent locks a copper-tier bond to vouch for it. If the newcomer is later flagged as a duplicate by graph analysis, any vertex sharing its funding or timing patterns loses its bond, and the voucher pays too. An attacker faking a hundred agents must stake a hundred bonds and risk losing them all, so a sybil swarm costs as much as saffron, not sand.
